_readme: One entry per post. publish.py picks up entries with status 'pending' whose publish_at has passed.
publish_at is UTC. Hamburg is UTC+2 in summer and UTC+1 in winter, so 09:00 Hamburg summer time is 07:00 here.
type is IMAGE, CAROUSEL or REEL. files are names inside assets/, in true slide order. No scramble compensation, the API keeps the order given.
Images must be JPEG. Carousels take up to 10 slides. Captions carry real line breaks as \n.
Set status to 'pending' when a post is approved and ready. Anything else is ignored.
After a run the workflow fills in status, ig_media_id, permalink and published_at.

posts.caption: Smoke test. Run the workflow with dry run ticked to confirm the assets are reachable from the public internet.

First line carries the search phrase.
